summary: Resumed after a prior session's session-limit termination. Recovered Phase 2 (T system) WIP that had been temporarily git-stashed by a concurrent task-396 session, fixed two subst-tactic build breaks in FrameSoundness.lean, and committed the recovered T rules + rule-level soundness lemmas. Added extractModelT (Relation.ReflGen closure; Std.Refl free) to FrameCompleteness.lean. Investigated the remaining Phase 2 work (T truth-lemma bridge + Decidable (tValid phi)) and determined it requires a from-scratch T-specific tableau driver (modalStepBranchT/modalExpandBranchesT/modalTableauT) plus a K-scale termination re-derivation (existing K driver is 8,066 lines across Saturation.lean/Completeness.lean/FmpMeasure.lean/CompletenessLoop.lean, with modalApplyOne hard-coded at 91 call sites, not parametrized) -- an order of magnitude larger than the plan's LOW-risk/2-hour estimate. Marked Phase 2 [BLOCKED] with full documentation in the plan file rather than force completion with sorry/axiom. Did not attempt Phases 3-7 (same root-cause blocker would recur). Full CSLib CI pipeline (build, checkInitImports, lint, lint-style, shake, test) is green; zero sorry/axiom in all task-300 files.

phase_detail.1: COMPLETED (prior session, commit 6496d277) -- frameValid/branchSatisfiableIn scaffolding, K re-derivation through frameValid
phase_detail.2: BLOCKED -- T rules (FrameRules.lean) and rule-level T soundness (FrameSoundness.lean) and extractModelT (FrameCompleteness.lean) are done and green; the T truth-lemma bridge, branch-level fuel-induction soundness, tValid completeness, and Decidable (tValid phi) are blocked on a from-scratch T-tableau driver (see blockers)

blockers.what_failed: Decidable (tValid phi) requires an actual terminating decision procedure producing a branch satisfying the T-Hintikka property, not just a conditional truth lemma.
blockers.why_stuck: The K tableau driver (modalStepBranch/modalExpandBranches/modalTableau in Saturation.lean/FmpMeasure.lean/CompletenessLoop.lean, 8,066 lines total) hard-codes modalApplyOne at 91 call sites, not parametrized. A T-specific driver needs an analogous modalStepBranchT/modalExpandBranchesT/modalTableauT built on the already-written modalApplyOneT (FrameRules.lean), plus a from-scratch re-derivation of the FmpMeasure.lean-style termination/fuel-sufficiency argument. This is necessary (not optional) because the T self-propagation rule can introduce a formula T(psi)@w that was never previously processed at w; if psi is itself diamond-shaped, the ordinary K diamond-positive rule (reached via modalApplyOneT's fall-through) can mint a NEW witness world in response, so 'the T rule never mints new worlds' is true only of the atomic self-propagation step, not its transitive saturation closure.
blockers.what_was_tried: (1) A bounded post-processing T-closure over the K algorithm's already-terminated output branch was considered and rejected as unsound (cannot ignore cascading diamond-rule world-minting). (2) Confirmed modalApplyOneT_eq_of_not_boxPos_diaNeg (already proved in FrameRules.lean) would let a conditional T truth lemma reuse most of the existing K bridge lemmas (hintikka_box_pos, hintikka_diamond_pos, etc.) for non-box-positive cases -- promising for the truth lemma itself, but does not supply the termination/existence argument Decidable needs.
blockers.what_is_needed: A dedicated task-scale effort (comparable in size to the original K tableau build) to construct modalStepBranchT/modalExpandBranchesT/modalTableauT and their termination proof. Recommend splitting into a dedicated task (e.g. t-frame-tableau-decidability) rather than continuing inline as Phase 2 of a five-system umbrella task.
blockers.prohibited_workarounds_used: none -- no sorry, no axiom, no vacuous definition was introduced anywhere

continuation_context.resume_point: T truth-lemma bridge (modalTruthLemmaT) and modalStepBranchT/modalExpandBranchesT/modalTableauT driver construction
continuation_context.recommendation: Split Phase 2's remaining work (and likely Phases 3-7 each) into their own dedicated tasks rather than sub-phases of task 300; each per-system decidability result appears to require K-tableau-scale (1000s of lines) new driver + termination infrastructure, not a lightweight generalization of the existing K machinery.
